'''Tyrru''' was a potent type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that was highly effective as a euphoric [[Painkiller/Legends|pain reliever]]. It was commonly used on [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to keep them manageable. It was highly addictive and had a number of side effects. Addicts who didn't get their daily dose of tyrru would [[Death/Legends|die]] a painful death.<ref name="Mask" />
